proves.claim: SEAT_LOOP tells a seat to run next --wait 1, repeat at once on an empty answer, stop only when status shows nothing open, and stay within its word budget.

config.io-templates.seat-loop-waits.why: Without this case the stock loop could go back to idling or stopping after four empty answers.

proves.claim: The Claude worker skill and the Codex automation carry the same wait and stop lines as SEAT_LOOP.

config.io-templates.skill-and-automation.why: Without this case a generated harness copy could drift from the AGENTS.md loop.

proves.claim: SEAT_LOOP lists every exported reject reason on its Reject line.

config.io-templates.seat-loop-reject-rea.why: Without this case the stock loop could omit supported reject reasons.

proves.claim: SEAT_LOOP and the worker skill name the seat folder for next, status and shout, and name NOT_JOINED otherwise.

config.io-templates.seat-loop-seat-folde.why: Without this case generated worker guidance could direct workers to run from the item folder.
